description:
The starting option.
A timeless classic.
Not everyone likes it, but it's still a strong contender for the most popular one.
Now with real strawberry pieces this time!
Classic vanilla flavour enhanced with little pieces of chocolate goodness, like some kind of delicious student exchange program.
It might be a bit more expensive but it sure is worth its cost, if you are the type who is into it.

It doesn't quite taste like coffee, neither does it actually have any caffeine, although for some people who don't usually drink coffee these are the actual reasons they buy it. Surprisingly popular in some northeastern US states and Patagonia.
